payment_policy.description: Strictly 100% Cashless. Alexandra Palace operates entirely without cash. All arena bars, street-food stalls, and official merchandise counters accept card and contactless mobile payments only (Apple Pay, Google Pay, Visa, Mastercard). Cash is not accepted anywhere inside the venue.

challenge_25.rule: Challenge 25 age verification is strictly enforced at every bar. Valid photographic government ID (passport or photocard driving license) is required for anyone appearing under 25.

intoxication_policy.rule: In compliance with UK licensing laws, venue security and bar supervisors will refuse alcohol service and eject excessively intoxicated, aggressive, or disruptive individuals.

free_water.rule: Complimentary drinking water refill points are available inside the venue concourse. Spectators may bring empty reusable plastic water bottles (or factory-sealed water bottles up to 500ml) through security checkpoints.

outside_alcohol.rule: Outside alcohol, unsealed bottles, glass containers, and metal cans are strictly prohibited and will be confiscated at bag check.

the_phoenix_bar_and_pizzeria.title: The Phoenix Bar & Pizzeria
the_phoenix_bar_and_pizzeria.description: Alexandra Palace's permanent on-site pub and pizzeria featuring panoramic terrace views overlooking the London skyline. Operates year-round with indoor seating and a large heated outdoor terrace.
the_phoenix_bar_and_pizzeria.access_rules: Open to ticket holders and park visitors prior to Great Hall session entry. Highly frequented on match days; arriving early is recommended.
the_phoenix_bar_and_pizzeria.atmosphere: Traditional gastro-pub offerings, stone-baked pizzas, draught craft ales, and terrace seating.

draught_and_pitchers.title: Arena Draught Bars & Pitcher Service
draught_and_pitchers.description: In recent World Championships, massive high-throughput draught bars have operated across the Great Hall, famously serving 4-pint draught beer pitchers to speed up service for group table seating. Reusable souvenir stack cups with interlocking handles have been utilized to cut plastic waste.
draught_and_pitchers.confirmation_note: Established tournament operational format. Specific 2026/27 tournament drinks menus, cup deposit amounts, and pricing will be confirmed upon tournament commencement.

fan_village_street_food.title: Palm Court Street Food Village
fan_village_street_food.description: The Palm Court concourse hosts an indoor street-food village for spectators before and during sessions. Typical food offerings across recent championships have included smash burgers, stone-baked sourdough pizza, hog roast baps, fried chicken tenders, and vegan/vegetarian wraps.
example_traders_recent_editions: Smash burgers and loaded seasoned fries
Slow-roasted hog roast rolls with crackling
Vegetarian halloumi wraps and vegan falafel boxes
Churros, sweet waffles, and barista coffee
fan_village_street_food.dietary_notes: Vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free choices are consistently provided across event catering lineups.
fan_village_street_food.confirmation_note: Menu items and street food traders rotate annually. The specific vendor lineup and pricing for the 2026/27 tournament will be published closer to December 2026.

session_timing_advisories.afternoon_session: Afternoon sessions typically finish around 16:30 GMT. Restaurants and eateries in Muswell Hill Broadway and Wood Green High Road operate normal dinner services.
session_timing_advisories.evening_session: Evening sessions typically conclude around 23:00 GMT. Most suburban neighborhood pubs in North London close or stop serving at 23:00. Spectators wishing to continue celebrations typically travel toward Finsbury Park or central London where extended late-night licenses operate.

source: Alexandra Palace Visitor Regulations & Trading Standards (Permanent Facilities); Recent World Championship Spectator Archives (Event Catering)
